Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building ages, sizes, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Sections 7, 8, and Appendix).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections through 2025-26 with methodology; includes capacity utilization data by site and grade; connects enrollment projections to specific facility actions including new construction, modernization, and adaptive space use (Section 3.2, Section 7).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational specifications for classrooms, labs, CTE, special education, wellness centers, and collaborative spaces; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; projects respond directly to educational needs (Section 4, Program Vision & Standards).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Districtwide data on outdoor spaces including square footage of green surfaces, shade coverage, and stormwater management; detailed strategies for campus greening such as tree cover expansion, permeable surfaces, outdoor classrooms, rain gardens, and bioswales; frames outdoor spaces as climate resilience strategies and supports outdoor learning (Sections 4.2, 5.1, 7).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate impacts and resilience strategies with some detail; includes shade structures, stormwater management, HVAC upgrades for air quality, and energy resilience measures; climate readiness is a theme in the plan but not fully districtwide or site-specific for all risks (Sections 5, 7).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Positions energy resilience and efficiency as core to the plan; provides district-wide energy use data and targets; includes electrification plans, renewable integration, solar + storage, microgrids; references state requirements (Title 24, ZNE goals); connects energy improvements to climate disruptions and cost savings (Sections 6, 7).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates by project and scope category; clear prioritization framework based on equity, safety, program alignment, and community input; multiple funding sources identified including bonds, state programs, developer fees, ESSER, and alternative financing; considers long-term sustainability and aligns financial capacity with educational priorities (Sections 5, 6).
